dialogues.en:
We're so close that if I poke out my lips a little bit, I
can touch her lips......
dialogues.text:
We're so close that if I poke out my lips a little bit, I
can touch her lips......

dialogues.en: (......Good idea...)
dialogues.text: (......Good idea...)

dialogues.jp:
目が覚めたっていうのに、寝ている時と同じく
らい、身体が動きやしない。金縛りでも、ここ
までカチカチにはさせないはず。
dialogues.en: I lift the back of my neck and move it forward......
dialogues.text: I lift the back of my neck and move it forward......

dialogues.jp:
眠りから覚めると、目の前に、頼子さんの寝顔
があった。

膝枕をしているうちに、頼子さんも眠くなって
しまったのだろう。

二人、額を突き合わせるようにして眠って、そ
して、今は夜だった。
dialogues.en:
She woke up! She slowly brings her upper body up and looks
at me, rubbing her eyes.
dialogues.text:
She woke up! She slowly brings her upper body up and looks
at me, rubbing her eyes.

dialogues.jp: （くぁ……それにしても……）
dialogues.en: I whistle and pretend that I just noticed her waking up.
dialogues.text: I whistle and pretend that I just noticed her waking up.

dialogues.jp:
起きている時の頼子さんは、どちらかというと
美人という印象なのだが、寝顔はそれにあどけ
なさが加わって、何だか最強。
dialogues.en:
"Oh, hey. You woke up. Haha, look at the sky. The stars are
shining beautifully tonight."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, hey. You woke up. Haha, look at the sky. The stars are
shining beautifully tonight."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah, I can't see any stars, because of the clouds......?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I can't see any stars, because of the clouds......?"

dialogues.jp:
跳ね起きた。頼子さんはゆったりと上体を起こ
すと、目を擦りつつ俺を見上げた。
dialogues.en:
She murmurs suspiciously, looking in the direction I'm
pointing.
dialogues.text:
She murmurs suspiciously, looking in the direction I'm
pointing.

dialogues.jp:
慣れない口笛なんかを吹き、たった今気がつい
たというように、頼子さんに顔を向けた。
dialogues.en:
"......I mean it looks beautiful to the eyes of my heart,
you know."
dialogues.text:
"......I mean it looks beautiful to the eyes of my heart,
you know."

dialogues.jp:
「や、やあ、目が覚めたんだ。はは、見てみな
　よ、今夜も星が綺麗だ」
dialogues.en: I lower my hand while speaking in tongues.
dialogues.text: I lower my hand while speaking in tongues.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Anyway, it's already late. I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, it's already late. I'm sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、その……曇り空ではないですか……？」
dialogues.en: "What? Why...... are you sorry?"
dialogues.text: "What? Why...... are you sorry?"

dialogues.jp:
俺の手の先に視線を向けた頼子さんが、不思議
そうに呟く。
dialogues.en:
"It was supposed to be our date, but I fell asleep and
ruined the rest of the day."
dialogues.text:
"It was supposed to be our date, but I fell asleep and
ruined the rest of the day."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　何が……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "......But I could be with you."
dialogues.text: "......But I could be with you."

dialogues.jp:
頬に手をあて、笑みを浮かべる。小さくあくび
をすると、頼子さんは立ち上がった。
dialogues.en:
She brings her hand to her cheek and smiles. She gives a
small yawn and stands up.
dialogues.text:
She brings her hand to her cheek and smiles. She gives a
small yawn and stands up.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……寒いです」
dialogues.en: "......I'm getting cold."
dialogues.text: "......I'm getting cold."

dialogues.jp:
両肩を｛か／掻｝き抱き、小さく震える。俺はごく自然
に、肩に手を回すことが出来た。
dialogues.en:
She holds her shoulders and shakes a bit. So I can naturally
put my arm around her.
dialogues.text:
She holds her shoulders and shakes a bit. So I can naturally
put my arm around her.

dialogues.jp: 「ともかく、下りよう」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home."

dialogues.jp:
辺りに人の姿はなく、確かに、身体はすっかり
冷え切っていた。
dialogues.en:
At this time of the day, there's already no one around, and
I'm also getting cold.
dialogues.text:
At this time of the day, there's already no one around, and
I'm also getting cold.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、寄りたい所があるんです」
dialogues.en: "There's a place I want to go before we go back home."
dialogues.text: "There's a place I want to go before we go back home."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　どこ？」
dialogues.en: "What? Where is it?"
dialogues.text: "What? Where is it?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「桜を……見に行きませんか？」
dialogues.en: "I would like to go see...... a cherry tree."
dialogues.text: "I would like to go see...... a cherry tree."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「桜？　そんなの、どこでだって……」
dialogues.en: "A cherry tree? You can see them anywhere......"
dialogues.text: "A cherry tree? You can see them anywhere......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「この島で、たった１本だけの…特別な桜です」
dialogues.en: "There's one special cherry tree on this island......"
dialogues.text: "There's one special cherry tree on this island......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……特別な、桜？」
dialogues.en: "......Special cherry tree?"
dialogues.text: "......Special cherry tree?"

dialogues.jp:
問い返すが、その意味するところはなんとなく
見当がついていた。
dialogues.en: I ask, but I know what she means.
dialogues.text: I ask, but I know what she means.

dialogues.jp: 「分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay."

dialogues.jp: そこに向かって、ゆっくりと歩いていく。
dialogues.en: We start to walk to that place.
dialogues.text: We start to walk to that place.

dialogues.jp: ほんの少しだけ、肩に置いた手に力を込めた。
dialogues.en: I slightly tighten my grip on her shoulder.
dialogues.text: I slightly tighten my grip on her shoulder.

dialogues.jp: ヒミツキチ。
dialogues.en: It's my secret hideout.
dialogues.text: It's my secret hideout.

dialogues.jp: その昔、そんな言葉で呼んでいた場所だ。
dialogues.en: That's what I used to call the place when I was little.
dialogues.text: That's what I used to call the place when I was little.

dialogues.jp:
島にあるたくさんの桜を“子ども”だとすると、
ここの桜は“大人”だった。
dialogues.en:
If you call the cherry trees on this island "children', this
cherry tree is like 'a mother".
dialogues.text:
If you call the cherry trees on this island "children', this
cherry tree is like 'a mother".

dialogues.jp:
ひときわ大きくて、ひときわたくさんの桜の花
をその身にまとっている。
dialogues.en:
It's bigger and has more blossoms than any other cherry
tree.
dialogues.text:
It's bigger and has more blossoms than any other cherry
tree.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱりここは……花びらが凄いですね……」
dialogues.en: "There are so many petals here......"
dialogues.text: "There are so many petals here......"

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、桜の大木に近づくと、幹にそっと
手を触れ、頭上を仰いだ。
dialogues.en:
She walks towards the base of the tree. She touches its
trunk and looks up.
dialogues.text:
She walks towards the base of the tree. She touches its
trunk and looks up.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「これが、人の願いを叶えてくれる桜……」
dialogues.en:
"This is the cherry tree that makes people's wishes come
true......"
dialogues.text:
"This is the cherry tree that makes people's wishes come
true......"

dialogues.jp:
振り返り、微笑んだ──らしい。桜の影が落ち
て、表情が分かりにくくなっている。
dialogues.en:
She turns around and smiles -- I think. It's hard for me to
see the expression on her face because she's in a shadow.
dialogues.text:
She turns around and smiles -- I think. It's hard for me to
see the expression on her face because she's in a shadow.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何だか──」
dialogues.en: "It looks like..."
dialogues.text: "It looks like..."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「──みたいですね」
dialogues.en: "......don't you think?"
dialogues.text: "......don't you think?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……え？　何て言ったの？　風でよく聞こえ
　なかった」
dialogues.en:
"......What? What did you say? I couldn't hear you because
of the wind."
dialogues.text:
"......What? What did you say? I couldn't hear you because
of the wind."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「魔女みたいですねって、そう言ったんです」
dialogues.en: "I said it looks like a witch."
dialogues.text: "I said it looks like a witch."

dialogues.jp: あれはやはり、彼女の夢だった。
dialogues.en: It was her dream.
dialogues.text: It was her dream.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「魔女のように、何でも望みを叶えてしまう。
　その力がある。……でも……」
dialogues.en:
"It's like a witch and has the power to make any wishes come
true. ......But......"
dialogues.text:
"It's like a witch and has the power to make any wishes come
true. ......But......"

dialogues.jp: 桜の影からすっと出てきた彼女は──、
dialogues.en: She comes out slowly from the shadow......
dialogues.text: She comes out slowly from the shadow......

dialogues.jp: やはり、寂しげな笑顔を浮かべていた。
dialogues.en: And she has the sad smile again.
dialogues.text: And she has the sad smile again.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「私は、私のために頑張らなければならない」
dialogues.en: "I have to try hard on my own."
dialogues.text: "I have to try hard on my own."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……そう、ですよね……？」
dialogues.en: "......Is that right......?"
dialogues.text: "......Is that right......?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……ああ。そうだな」
dialogues.en: "......Yeah, that's right."
dialogues.text: "......Yeah, that's right."

dialogues.jp:
単純に考えていた物事の土台が、さらさらと崩
れていくのを感じる。
dialogues.en:
I feel like the fundamentals of something that I used to
treat naively have started to fall apart.
dialogues.text:
I feel like the fundamentals of something that I used to
treat naively have started to fall apart.

dialogues.jp: 望みを叶えてくれるって、何だろう？
dialogues.en: What kind of a wish is she talking about?
dialogues.text: What kind of a wish is she talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「一人の少女が居ました」
dialogues.en: "There was a young girl."
dialogues.text: "There was a young girl."

dialogues.jp:
昔語りのように、頼子さんは語りだした。桜の
木に身体を向けて。
dialogues.en:
Facing the tree, she start to talk like she's reading a
book.
dialogues.text:
Facing the tree, she start to talk like she's reading a
book.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「とても、臆病な少女でした」
dialogues.en: "She was a very timid girl."
dialogues.text: "She was a very timid girl."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「家の中、部屋の内側が、少女の全てでした」
dialogues.en: "Her house and her room was everything to her."
dialogues.text: "Her house and her room was everything to her."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「一匹の猫がいて、その子に語りかけるんです」
dialogues.en: "There was a cat, and she always talked to the cat."
dialogues.text: "There was a cat, and she always talked to the cat."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あの人が好き。とても、好き、と」
dialogues.en: "She told the cat that she likes the boy very much."
dialogues.text: "She told the cat that she likes the boy very much."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう。少女には好きな人が居たんです」
dialogues.en: "Yes, she liked a boy."
dialogues.text: "Yes, she liked a boy."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「臆病だから、窓から見る事しか出来ませんで
　したけれど……」
dialogues.en:
"But she was so shy and all she could do was to see him from
her window."
dialogues.text:
"But she was so shy and all she could do was to see him from
her window."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「相手の人は、ついに、その少女を知ってはく
　れませんでしたけれど……」
dialogues.en: "And the boy never knew her and never got to know her......"
dialogues.text: "And the boy never knew her and never got to know her......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「その人の名前は──」
dialogues.en: "And that boy's name was......"
dialogues.text: "And that boy's name was......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「頼子さんっ！」
dialogues.en: "Yoriko-san!"
dialogues.text: "Yoriko-san!"

dialogues.jp:
二の腕を掴んで挟み込む。さっき目が覚めた時
と、同じくらいには近い距離で。
dialogues.en:
I grab her arms and get close to her face, just like when I
woke up earlier.
dialogues.text:
I grab her arms and get close to her face, just like when I
woke up earlier.

dialogues.jp:
「今の話が、俺に関係があるのかどうか、それ
　は知らない」
dialogues.en: "I don't know if the story has anything to do with me."
dialogues.text: "I don't know if the story has anything to do with me."

dialogues.jp:
「けれど、あったとしても、俺は、頼子さんに
　言わなくちゃならない事があるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"But even if it is something to do with me, I have something
that I need to tell you."
dialogues.text:
"But even if it is something to do with me, I have something
that I need to tell you."

dialogues.jp: 「俺、頼子さんが好きなんだ」
dialogues.en: "I love you, Yoriko-san."
dialogues.text: "I love you, Yoriko-san."

dialogues.jp: 言葉を封じるように、唇を｛ふさ／塞｝ぐ。
dialogues.en:
I seal her lips with mine as if I was trying to silence her
voice.
dialogues.text:
I seal her lips with mine as if I was trying to silence her
voice.

dialogues.jp:
身体が冷えていたせいだろうか、ひんやりとし
た唇だった。
dialogues.en: Her lips are cold. Maybe because she's been cold.
dialogues.text: Her lips are cold. Maybe because she's been cold.

dialogues.jp: 熱を伝えるように、そっと唇を重ねている。
dialogues.en: I put my lips onto hers as if I was warming them up.
dialogues.text: I put my lips onto hers as if I was warming them up.

dialogues.jp:
初めて知った彼女のその部分の感触は、とても
柔かくて……。
dialogues.en: I feel her touch for the first time, and it's so soft......
dialogues.text: I feel her touch for the first time, and it's so soft......

dialogues.jp:
いつまでもこうしていられたらと、そんな考え
が浮かぶ。
dialogues.en: And I want to stay like this as long as I can.
dialogues.text: And I want to stay like this as long as I can.

dialogues.jp: 塞がれていた唇が、言葉を結んだ。
dialogues.en: Her sealed lips start to move.
dialogues.text: Her sealed lips start to move.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「突然……ですね」
dialogues.en: "I wasn't expecting that......"
dialogues.text: "I wasn't expecting that......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「好きなんだ。その感情は、突然じゃない」
dialogues.en: "I really do love you. And I have for a long time."
dialogues.text: "I really do love you. And I have for a long time."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私……私も……朝倉さんの事が、好きです
　……」
dialogues.en: "I...... I...... love you too, Junichi-san."
dialogues.text: "I...... I...... love you too, Junichi-san."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ずっと……ずっと……好きだったんです……」
dialogues.en: "I always...... always...... loved you......"
dialogues.text: "I always...... always...... loved you......"

dialogues.jp: トンと、指先が、俺の胸に軽く触れた。
dialogues.en: I feel her fingertips touching my chest.
dialogues.text: I feel her fingertips touching my chest.

dialogues.jp:
その｛わず／僅｝かな反動を利用するようにして、頼子さ
んは後ろに下がった。
dialogues.en: She uses the pressure to step back from me.
dialogues.text: She uses the pressure to step back from me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あなたの気持ちを……そして、私の気持ちを
　伝え合う事が出来て……嬉しいです」
dialogues.en:
"I'm happy to know...... how you feel about me... and to
have you knowing how I feel about you."
dialogues.text:
"I'm happy to know...... how you feel about me... and to
have you knowing how I feel about you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「これで、やっと……本当に決心が付きました」
dialogues.en: "And finally...... I've just made up my mind."
dialogues.text: "And finally...... I've just made up my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お別れする決心が……やっと」
dialogues.en: "To say goodbye......"
dialogues.text: "To say goodbye......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "......Goodbye?"
dialogues.text: "......Goodbye?"

dialogues.jp:
ガンッと、鈍器で頭を殴られたような衝撃を覚
えた。とさっという音が聞こえ、手からカゴが
滑り落ちたことに気がつく。
dialogues.en:
I feel like I've been hit by a hammer on my head. And I hear
the noise of something hitting the ground and realize I
dropped the lunch basket.
dialogues.text:
I feel like I've been hit by a hammer on my head. And I hear
the noise of something hitting the ground and realize I
dropped the lunch basket.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは微かな笑みを浮かべ、舞い散る桜の
中に立っている。
dialogues.en:
Yoriko-san's standing with a smile while cherry blossom
petals are falling down on her.
dialogues.text:
Yoriko-san's standing with a smile while cherry blossom
petals are falling down on her.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「さよならを言って……猫の姿に戻る決心です」
dialogues.en:
"I've made up my mind to say goodbye to you and go back to
being a cat again."
dialogues.text:
"I've made up my mind to say goodbye to you and go back to
being a cat again."

dialogues.jp:
意外な事に、俺の口から漏れたのは、静かな声
だった。
dialogues.en: Unexpectedly, I can only agree quietly.
dialogues.text: Unexpectedly, I can only agree quietly.

dialogues.jp:
もちろん、ショックはある。けれど、心のどこ
かで、予期していたことではなかったか。
dialogues.en:
Of course I'm shocked. But I knew somewhere in my heart that
this would happen some day.
dialogues.text:
Of course I'm shocked. But I knew somewhere in my heart that
this would happen some day.

dialogues.jp:
“つう”は、人間の世界で幸せな時を過ごした
後、結局、元の姿に戻って、去っていくのだ。
dialogues.en:
After the crane spent a wonderful time as a human, she goes
back to being a crane and goes home.
dialogues.text:
After the crane spent a wonderful time as a human, she goes
back to being a crane and goes home.

dialogues.jp: たぶん、これも、そんな物語。
dialogues.en: I think our story is going to be the same.
dialogues.text: I think our story is going to be the same.

dialogues.jp:
その声は、静かだけれど、｛かす／掠｝れて、震えを帯び
ていた。
dialogues.en: My voice is calm, but hoarse and trembling.
dialogues.text: My voice is calm, but hoarse and trembling.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「２９日に日付が変わった……その時に」
dialogues.en: "At midnight when the day of the 29th starts......"
dialogues.text: "At midnight when the day of the 29th starts......"

dialogues.jp: 実質、あと三日。
dialogues.en: 3 more days left.
dialogues.text: 3 more days left.

dialogues.jp:
それだけで、頼子さんは消えてしまうのだ。目
の前から。
dialogues.en: 3 more days and Yoriko-san will disappear from me.
dialogues.text: 3 more days and Yoriko-san will disappear from me.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「お願いがあるんです」
dialogues.en: "I have a favor to ask you."
dialogues.text: "I have a favor to ask you."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「……いいぜ。今日は半日潰しちゃったからな。
　給料の内、半日分はまだ残っている」
dialogues.en:
"......Okay. I slept for half a day on our date, so you
still have the half day left as your paycheck."
dialogues.text:
"......Okay. I slept for half a day on our date, so you
still have the half day left as your paycheck."

dialogues.jp: 精一杯の笑顔を浮かべ、俺はそう言った。
dialogues.en: I tell her, trying to smile as much as I can.
dialogues.text: I tell her, trying to smile as much as I can.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「これからの日々を、いつもと同じように過ご
　して下さい」
dialogues.en: "Please spend the rest of the days as you always do."
dialogues.text: "Please spend the rest of the days as you always do."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「朝、目覚めて、私の作った朝食を食べて、行っ
　てきますと学園へ向かって……」
dialogues.en:
"You wake up in the morning, eat the breakfast I make, go to
school......"
dialogues.text:
"You wake up in the morning, eat the breakfast I make, go to
school......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「ただいまと帰ってきて、私の作った夕食を食
　べて、お風呂に入って、ベッドに入る……」
dialogues.en:
"You come back from school, eat the dinner I make, take a
shower, and go to bed......"
dialogues.text:
"You come back from school, eat the dinner I make, take a
shower, and go to bed......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「そんな、毎日の生活を、日常を、私と一緒に
　過ごして下さい」
dialogues.en: "Please do the same thing you always do."
dialogues.text: "Please do the same thing you always do."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「おやすいご用だ」
dialogues.en: "That's easy."
dialogues.text: "That's easy."

dialogues.jp:
心の中までは、期待に添えるかどうか、分から
なかったけれど……、
dialogues.en: I'm not sure if it will be easy in my heart.
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if it will be easy in my heart.

dialogues.jp: 俺はそう答えた。
dialogues.en: But I say yes.
dialogues.text: But I say yes.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「……帰りましょう」
dialogues.en: "......Let's go home."
dialogues.text: "......Let's go home."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp: ごく自然に、寄り添って。
dialogues.en: We naturally walk side by side.
dialogues.text: We naturally walk side by side.

dialogues.jp: 俺達は、桜公園を後にしたのだった。
dialogues.en: And we leave Sakura Park.
dialogues.text: And we leave Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp: ◆別れ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 目をあけるとすぐ側に頼子さんの寝顔があった。

どうやら俺は膝枕をしてもらっているうちに眠っ
てしまっていたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I'm awake but I can't move my body at all. Even being in a
straitjacket wouldn't make my body stiff like this.
dialogues.text:
I'm awake but I can't move my body at all. Even being in a
straitjacket wouldn't make my body stiff like this.

dialogues.jp:
寄りたいところがあるという頼子さんに連れら
れ、向かったのは、この島で一本だけの特別な
桜の樹。
dialogues.en:
When I wake up, there is Yoriko-san's sleeping face in front
of my eyes.
dialogues.text:
When I wake up, there is Yoriko-san's sleeping face in front
of my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 矢張り先ほどの夢は頼子さんの夢だったらしい。
dialogues.en:
It seems like she got sleepy and fell asleep while offering
me her knees as a pillow.
dialogues.text:
It seems like she got sleepy and fell asleep while offering
me her knees as a pillow.

dialogues.jp:
俺は彼女の正体はどうでもよくて、自分の事を
話そうとする頼子さんの言葉を｛さえぎ／遮｝り、自分の気
持ちを告白したのだった。
dialogues.en: We were sleeping together face to face, and night fell.
dialogues.text: We were sleeping together face to face, and night fell.

dialogues.jp:
その言葉を聴いて、猫に戻る決心がついたとい
う頼子さん。
dialogues.en: (She looks so......)
dialogues.text: (She looks so......)

dialogues.jp: あと三日で彼女は消えてしまう。
dialogues.en:
When she's awake, she looks so beautiful, but when she's
sleeping, there's a cuteness to it and she looks super
beautiful and cute.
dialogues.text:
When she's awake, she looks so beautiful, but when she's
sleeping, there's a cuteness to it and she looks super
beautiful and cute.

dialogues.jp:
俺は頼子さんに、残りの日々、いつも通りの日
常を送ることを約束したのだった。
dialogues.en:
I hear her sleeping soundly. Our faces are so close that I
can feel her breaths on my face.
dialogues.text:
I hear her sleeping soundly. Our faces are so close that I
can feel her breaths on my face.
